domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by molecular-biology practice for relative quantification by real-time PCR: which wells are reportable replicates, how a dilution series gives an amplification factor, what a no-template control signal means, replicate outlier handling, reference-gene normalisation by geometric mean with each assay's own efficiency, and the calibrator-relative fold change. The code is ordinary Python arithmetic; the judgement in every graded figure is the lab biology the SOP encodes, so Software would misplace it and no other Science subcategory fits.
evidence: instruction.md: the SOP is the authority for the facility's relative-expression report; symptoms are biological reporting errors (efficiency above 100 per cent, stray replicate wells, late primer-dimer NTC, missing reference gene)

environment/app/docs/relative-expression-sop.md: a numbered core-facility qPCR SOP (cut-off cycle, curve points, standard curve, contamination, outliers, Pfaffl-type efficiency-corrected relative quantity, geometric-mean normalisation, flags)

planned verifier and the skeleton scorer (authoring/score_skeleton.py): whole-report comparison of per-gene factors and contamination and per-sample mean Ct, fold change and flags against solution/model.py, which is derived from the SOP
